title: About Me
content:
I got into software through web development, but over time I became interested in everything around the product — how it performs, how accessible it is, how people find it, and what is happening behind the interface.

Professionally, I have worked across frontend development, accessibility, technical SEO, performance, and CMS-driven platforms. I enjoy the kind of work where I can dig into a problem, understand why something is not behaving as it should, and actually fix it.

Outside of work, I am usually building something of my own. I have experimented with AI and model fine-tuning, built developer tools, contributed to multilingual AI projects, and probably started more side projects than I should have.

If you are building something interesting and think I could help, let’s have a chat :)
